regime_context: The Canada/TSX thematic landscape shows Big Banks leading with strong absolute-trend eligibility but also elevated crowding. Rotation is broad (11 of 16 eligible) but not directional; no single narrative dominates. The absolute trend gate has historically reduced drawdowns in this market.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff: if Base Metals & Copper (XBM.TO) overtakes Big Banks (ZEB.TO) as the leader in the narrative rotation and becomes the new headline, the rotation would be confirmed.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks ranks #1 with intact trend eligibility and high durability, supported by full breadth across the bank basket. The overweight is a trend-following lean, but crowding suggests capping, not chasing.
theses.dissent: Crowding (z=1.05) raises the risk of a shake-out; the momentum rank itself has no forward return edge, and the gate only controls drawdown, not upside.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO loses eligibility (falls below the absolute-trend gate that keeps the theme active).

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs rank near the bottom (12th) with negative momentum and subdued breadth. Despite eligibility, the mixed durability and weak relative position suggest underweighting relative to the benchmark.
theses.dissent: REITs could rally if rate expectations shift favorably; the detector's momentum rank is not a return predictor, so underweight is purely a risk-control stance, not a forecast of decline.

falsifier.text: REITs (XRE.TO) rise into the top 5 of the thematic momentum ranks and maintain eligibility for at least 5 trading days.
